title: Three Months and One Short Chair
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：sofa　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sofa 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the father ① bought the sofa that no neighbour in the house would have recorded, and he said the buying was the whole of the month. The ② sofa, meaning the seat itself and not the chair, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a sofa, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sofa in that house had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ sofa at the far door, meaning the box they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sofa, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the father said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sofa was the whole of the matter, meaning the comfort and not the seat. The ⑥ sofa, meaning the comfort and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; sofa, he said, is either something you buy or the only word that means both a seat and a comfort. He said the comfort is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ sofa had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ sofa of the whole thing, the father wrote in September, was one house and three months of recording; sofa, he said, is either the box at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sofa I remember is the seat recorded in the letter, which closed in 1970 and is still recorded as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ sofa, my mother said in 1972, is the only seat that improves by being recorded; every sofa, she said, is a comfort that has agreed to look like a seat. She said the comfort was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 沙发（指老屋里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 沙发（指那张沙发本身，与小小的板凳相对）
C. 固定搭配：buy the sofa 添置这一张沙发
D. n. 沙发（指留给孩子们搬的那一只）
E. n. 沙发之事（抽象总称，指一处老屋的沙发之事）
F. n. 沙发（指家书里写到、被记载的那一张）
G. n. 沙发、舒适（指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 舒适（抽象总称，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bought the sofa that no neighbour in the house would have recorded
The sofa, meaning the seat itself and not the chair
the sofa at the far door
the sofa was the whole of the matter

answers.why: buy the sofa 意为“添置这一张沙发”，1963 年那位父亲把老屋里没有一位邻居肯记载的一张沙发做了一遍。
sofa 意为“沙发”，指那张沙发本身而不是小小的板凳，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
sofa 意为“沙发”，指老屋里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一张小小的板凳。
sofa 意为“沙发”，指最远那道门口的留给孩子们搬的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sofa 意为“沙发、舒适”，指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张舒适就是那件事的全部。
sofa 意为“舒适”，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张沙发，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sofa 意为“沙发”，指家书里写到、被记载的那一张，到 1968 年这一张成了家书里的一行。
sofa 意为“沙发之事”，父亲九月写道，整件事的沙发之事是一处老屋和三个月份的记载。
sofa 意为“沙发”，我记得的是家书里记载过的那一张，1970 年搬完了，至今仍被说成老屋里最安静的一张。
sofa 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，沙发是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的沙发。
